scene: The green key unlocks an arched plaza bustling with unusual transit gates.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a busy paved depot platform. Far left, a paint-splattered tram sits on tracks. Centre-left, the Pacific Islander girl holds her sketchbook and shining green key. Centre, an ornate glass revolving door lift waits. Far right, a striped rooftop gondola sways gently beside an iron boarding ramp.
shown: a colorful paint-splattered tram waiting with open doors on tracks at the far left
a glass revolving door lift glowing with brass dials in the centre
a striped rooftop gondola hanging from overhead cables at the far right
